# asc_file_storage_access (Data Source)

Retrieves an existing file storage access entry from the DSPC platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "asc_file_storage_access" "example" {
  file_storage_name = "my-file-storage"
  target_type       = "VirtualMachine"
  target_name       = "my-vm"
}

output "file_storage_access_id" {
  description = "The ID of the file storage access entry."
  value       = data.asc_file_storage_access.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_storage_name` (String) Name of the file storage.
- `target_name` (String) Name of the workload.
- `target_type` (String) Type of the workload. Valid values: VirtualMachine, Container.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this access entry ({file_storage_name}:{target_type}:{target_name}).
